verdict.rationale: Ledgy is a SaaS equity-management product, and publishing its source under an open license is a fair question for any software product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only its hosted app and its GraphQL API with service-account authentication. Nothing mentions a public source repository or an open-source license, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
